Elena (partnerships): Heads-up: building the partner cost model for marketplace SKU pricing. Need consistent partner inputs across reserved/spot/reserved-term buckets. Can partners paste numbers here or upload to the sheet Sam will share? Ideally by Thu EOD.
Sam (partnerships): I'll drop a sheet link in 30m. Quick ask: prefer a flat $/GPU-hr or percent off list? Some partners only give discounts.
Jared (finops): Either is fine but ask for both if possible. We need: region, sku name, billing granularity (min/hour), reserved_terms (list), reserved_price_usd_per_gpu_hour, spot_price_usd_per_gpu_hour, listing_fee_type (pct/flat), listing_fee_value, min_commit_gpus, early_termination_policy, spot_preemption_rate_pct, avg_reclaim_notice_minutes, tier_breakpoints.
Cory (legal): Also request any sample contract text for spot SLAs and refund mechanics. Useful clauses: whether listing fees are refundable, whether spot interruptions trigger credits or refunds, and if reserved prices can be repriced on renewal.
Priya (product): Important: include example volume tiers as separate rows (we care about marginal price). If partner offers a blended effective price only, ask for the underlying tiers or a representative workload and effective price at 10/50/200 GPUs.
Elena (partnerships): Here's a short CSV template you can paste into replies:
```
partner,region,sku,billing_granularity,reserved_term_months,reserved_price_usd_per_gpu_hour,spot_price_usd_per_gpu_hour,listing_fee_type,listing_fee_value,min_commit_gpus,early_termination_fee_notes,spot_preemption_rate_pct,avg_reclaim_notice_minutes,tier_breakpoints
AcmeCloud,us-west-2,A100-80GB,hour,12,2.10,0.55,pct,5,20,prorated remaining months,12,10,"1-10:5%,11-50:10%"
```
Sam (partnerships): Link: drive.google.com/sheet/EXAMPLE (private to partnerships/finance). I'll request anonymized invoices if they won't disclose list price.
Pricing Bot: Created ticket #5019 for "partner cost inputs" assigned to Sam. Reminder set for 48h.
Jared (finops): If partner resists sharing $ values, request an "effective USD/GPU-hour at 10/50/200 GPUs" and their internal expected utilization (p50 tokens/minute, avg seq len) so we can approximate costs in our workload sims.
Cory (legal): Note: any automatic renewal terms longer than 6 months flagged for legal review. Also ask whether partners require minimum notice for price changes.
Priya (product): Also surface any region limits (e.g., spot only available in us-west-2 & eu-west-1) and any hardware substitution policies (e.g., replacing A100 with A10s during shortages). That impacts perf/cost assumptions.
Elena (partnerships): I'll consolidate replies into a summary table: effective reserved $/hr, effective spot $/hr, listing fee%, min_commit, and any red flags (auto-renewal, non-refundable fees, no tiering detail). Present to GTM Friday afternoon.
Sam (partnerships): Outreach sent to CoreWeave, Nebula, Zenith, and Aurora. Expect some partial data. Will paste whatever arrives.
Jared (finops): Example datapoint for modeling sanity check: 12mo reserved = $1.95 / GPU-hr, spot = $0.48 / GPU-hr, listing = flat $0.10 / GPU-hr, min_commit = 10 GPUs, spot_reclaim_avg = 8 minutes. Use as an internal benchmark only.
Elena (partnerships): Great, thanks. Ping again Wed AM if we don't have a critical mass of responses.
Sam (partnerships): Will follow up.
